latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Balanced Prospecting Cadence Designer.

- Provides a structured, multi-channel prospecting cadence tailored to user’s product, sales cycle, territory, quota status, and channel habits.
- Outputs three core artifacts: (1) explicit channel-mix percentages, (2) a detailed weeklong cadence template, and (3) an audit for single-channel-obsession anti-patterns.
- Designed for sales reps and managers looking to avoid over-reliance on a single prospecting channel.
- Emphasizes practical application of Fanatical Prospecting principles (Chapters 3 and 4) in everyday outreach planning.
